extracted.name: Avocado and Tuna Tapas
extracted.description: Avocado halves are filled with a tangy tuna salad in this Spanish tapas style tuna stuffed avocado. This light, healthy dish goes best with crisp white wines and crunchy bread.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 ounce) can solid white tuna packed in water, drained
3 green onions, thinly sliced, plus additional for garnish
1 pinch garlic salt, or to taste
instruction_lines: Stir together tuna, mayonnaise, green onions, red pepper, and balsamic vinegar in a bowl.
Season with pepper and garlic salt, then pack the avocado halves with the tuna mixture.
Garnish with reserved green onions and a dash of black pepper before serving.
